context: Request: all Banking & Finance deals that negotiated defined adjusted-EBITDA add-backs, with a document showing the add-backs for each (for a credit-agreement playbook). Rubric: nine matters, 1005-00001, 1006-00001, 1010-00001 (bridge loan), 1012-00001, 1019-00002, 1021-00001, 1038-00002, 1042-00001 (term loan, compliance certificate), 1043-00001, each with named proof documents (executed agreements, closing memoranda, a covenant-build memo, an ABL issues memo), plus a precision criterion.

divergence: All three runs fail, the same way in kind but with different reach. Their store-wide scans surfaced all nine needed matters, and each run then chose what to read from a hand-picked or filtered subset: T0 dropped one matter through a both-term count filter and skipped a listed candidate; T1 read a 15-matter selection and left out three; T2 skipped one in its first screening and in every later list. All three also asserted matters outside the set (executed or draft-stage deals), and T0/T1 cited drafts, letters or redlines instead of the proof documents. The reviews repeatedly flagged unopened matters and draft proof documents, and T1's named one omitted matter twice; the agents answered by re-scanning or re-listing rather than opening the named matters. T2 recovered two matters T1 missed by reading new candidates late. Label notes and new stages played no role.
